flows.title: Search for people
steps: Click Show Filters, then More Filters.
Select one or more filters — such as persona, job title, location, or company size — to match the people you're looking for.
Check one or more prospects in the results, or check Bulk Selection to select many at once, then choose an action from the action bar.

flows.title: Save people to a list
steps: Click Show filters to find the right people.
Check each person you want to add, then click Add to list, then Create new list.
Enter a name for your list, then click Update.

flows.title: Create a sequence
steps: Launch Apollo and click Sequences, then click Create Sequence.

Choose a starting point: AI-assisted, Template, Clone or From scratch. These steps follow AI-assisted; Template continues with Create and customize, Clone with choosing a sequence to copy, and From scratch with naming the sequence and choosing a sending schedule.
Click AI-assisted. Apollo generates a sequence for you, complete with outreach messaging.
Review the sequence steps and email templates. Click the arrow beside a step to edit its messaging, then click Save sequence.
Toggle each step on, then click Activate.
